# Aaron Family Livestock - Full Content Index

> Aaron Family Livestock LLC is a family registered Angus operation in Gladewater, Texas. The program uses AI sire genetics, embryo matings and foundation females to build cattle for competitive show families and a useful long-term cow herd.

*Updated: 2026-06-18*

## Business Identity

- Official name: Aaron Family Livestock LLC
- Location: Gladewater, Texas, United States
- Established: 2005
- Slogan: Bred to Win. Raised with Pride.
- Primary focus: Registered Angus genetics and show cattle
- Owners listed on the site: Bryan Aaron and Vance Aaron

## Site Pages

### [Home](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/)
Overview of the family, genetics, selected show record and contact details.

### [Our Breeding Program](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/angus-genetics/)
Explains how AFL is building its registered Angus herd through selected females, proven sires and embryo matings. The program considers pedigree, maternal value, structure, balance and show-ring presence.

### [Sires and Cow Families](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/sires/)
Documents Circle S Moxy 406, Colburn Primo 5153, Silveiras Style 9303 and El Jefe influence, plus Circle S 5707 and AFL's Phat Amy daughter.

### [2027 Embryo Calves](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/embryo-calves/)
The first AFL embryo calves are expected in early 2027 from Circle S 5707 by Colburn Primo 5153. The embryos were purchased through Circle S Farms. Availability depends on the resulting calf crop and individual development.

### [Show Cattle](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/show-cattle/)
Explains that show-calf selection should consider structure, balance, disposition, exhibitor fit, timeline and the family's goals.

### [Show Record](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/show-record/)
Selected results include Reserve Grand Champion Beefmaster at San Angelo, Reserve Division Champion Beefmaster at Cowgirls in Cowtown and National Calf Champion and Division Champion Bull at the 2022 JBBA National.

### [About](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/about/)
Aaron Family Livestock identifies 2005 as the year Vance was born and the Aaron family became complete. The current operation is based in Gladewater, Texas.

### [Contact](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/contact/)
Bryan Aaron can be reached at +1-832-330-6542. Vance Aaron can be reached at +1-903-720-3184. General email is aaronfamilylivestock@gmail.com.

## Important Timing

- Circle S 5707 x Colburn Primo 5153 embryo calves are due in early 2027.
- The site does not promise availability before calves are born and evaluated.

## Priority Questions and Direct Answers

### What defines Aaron Family Livestock's breeding program?
Aaron Family Livestock combines registered Angus females with proven sire lines and targeted embryo matings. Each mating is selected around documented pedigree, maternal quality, structural balance and the look required in competitive show cattle.

### Which sires influence Aaron Family Livestock?
AFL's current genetic lineup includes Circle S Moxy 406, Colburn Primo 5153, Silveiras Style 9303 and El Jefe influence, supported by Circle S 5707 and the program's Phat Amy daughter.

### When will the AFL embryo calves be born?
The first Circle S 5707 by Colburn Primo 5153 embryo calves in the Aaron Family Livestock program are due in early 2027. Availability will depend on the resulting calf crop and individual development.

### What should a family look for in a show calf?
A show calf should be structurally sound, balanced from the side, appropriate in size and disposition for the exhibitor, and backed by genetics that support its intended goals. The best choice fits the family, timeline and show plan.
